system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — First Potomac Realty Trust realized record after whole-company merger, ~3-5-year horizon (~2020-2022)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the entity was merged out of existence
> and deregistered, there is no post-closing public 10-K for it; the traceable record
> is limited to the deregistration filing and a check of whether the acquiring
> registrant separately discloses the acquired business. This sub-dossier contains no
> information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)
- On October 12, 2017, a Form 15-12B was filed for First Potomac Realty Trust (CIK
  0001254595) certifying termination of registration of its common stock under the
  Exchange Act. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-061960, Form 15-12B]
- A search of First Potomac Realty Trust's (CIK 0001254595) EDGAR filing history for
  Form 10-K finds none filed after the pre-merger FY2016 annual report (filed
  2017-02-24); no periodic report covering fiscal years within the ~2020-2022 outcome
  window was located for this CIK. [SRC: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001254595&type=10-K]

## Acquirer's continuing public status and later identity
- The acquirer, Government Properties Income Trust ("GOV," CIK 0001456772), remained a
  reporting company after the merger. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-301026, Form
  8-K]
- By January 14, 2019, the same CIK (0001456772) was filing under the name "Office
  Properties Income Trust," identifying itself as "successor by merger to" Select
  Income REIT ("SIR") under a separate business management agreement with The RMR
  Group LLC ("RMR LLC"); i.e., the entity that had acquired First Potomac in 2017
  itself underwent a further merger and renaming before the ~2020-2022 outcome window.
  [SRC: SEC accession 0001456772-19-000006, Form 8-K]

## Search for separate disclosure of the acquired business (the no-record check)
- Office Properties Income Trust's Form 10-K for fiscal year 2020 (filed 2021-02-19)
  contains zero occurrences of "Potomac" anywhere in the filing text. [SRC: SEC
  accession 0001456772-21-000007, Form 10-K (FY2020)]
- Office Properties Income Trust's Form 10-K for fiscal year 2021 (filed 2022-02-16)
  likewise contains zero occurrences of "Potomac" anywhere in the filing text. [SRC:
  SEC accession 0001456772-22-000009, Form 10-K (FY2021)]
- No source was located in which Office Properties Income Trust (or its predecessor
  registrant) separately identifies or discloses a financial or operating trajectory
  (disposition, impairment, write-down, occupancy, or comparable scalar) specifically
  attributable to the former First Potomac Washington-D.C.-region office/business-park
  portfolio, as distinct from the registrant's consolidated results, within the
  ~2020-2022 window. [UNVERIFIED]

## Items sought but not found
- No reputable-press or primary source was located reporting a divestiture,
  impairment, write-down, bankruptcy, or comparable outcome scalar specifically tied
  to the former First Potomac portfolio within the ~2020-2022 window. General
  reporting on the Washington, D.C.-area office market and on the registrant's
  portfolio-wide activity exists but does not isolate this specific former-First-
  Potomac asset base, so it is not cited here as an outcome fact for this case.
  [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because First Potomac Realty Trust was merged out of existence and deregistered in
  October 2017, there is no public audited outcome record (10-K) for the ~2020-2022
  window for the acquired entity itself. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-061960,
  Form 15-12B]
- The acquiring registrant (Government Properties Income Trust, later Office
  Properties Income Trust, CIK 0001456772) remained a public filer through the outcome
  window, but its FY2020 and FY2021 Forms 10-K contain no separate reference to the
  former First Potomac portfolio. [SRC: SEC accession 0001456772-21-000007, Form 10-K
  (FY2020); SEC accession 0001456772-22-000009, Form 10-K (FY2021)]
- Per the no-record convention, this case is coded **uncertain** on the outcome: the
  absence of any disclosure separately isolating the acquired business precludes a
  sourced determination of its realized 3-5-year trajectory, and no inference is drawn
  from the acquirer's consolidated results.

[SLICE END]
